purpose: Staging area for EFIRIO Now Playing/history sources. Only sources confirmed on station/operator-owned sites are promoted to stations.json.

candidates.notes: Official site has a distinct Radio Vanya SPb stream page. Official playlist exposes artist/title and clock time. Need browser/CORS and SPb-specific parser validation before promotion.

candidates.regionalScope: city-selectable; Saint Petersburg must be resolved explicitly
candidates.notes: Official playlist exposes artist/title/time and a city selector. Search-visible query parameters do not reliably switch the rendered city, so no guessed region parameter is accepted. Need identify the actual site city-selection request/cookie/API before promotion.

candidates.regionalScope: Saint Petersburg station page (city/154), but playlist content is explicitly federal/Moscow
candidates.notes: Official city/154 page identifies Saint Petersburg 88.4 FM, but Avtoradio explicitly states that the playlist service currently contains only Moscow/federal-air tracks. Therefore this must NOT be represented as exact Saint Petersburg regional metadata. It may be used only later as clearly labelled federal/reference metadata if product policy allows it.

Official site recognizes region=spb: the regional surface identifies Saint Petersburg 100.5 FM and exposes SPb-specific programming such as Petersburg ONLINE. Exact underlying metadata payload and timestamp fields still require browser/API inspection before production promotion.

candidates.regionalScope: city-selectable; Saint Petersburg must be resolved explicitly
candidates.notes: Official broadcast modal exposes current/recent music and program information. Existing MTS JSON candidate remains separate because browser audit reported FETCH_OR_CORS.

candidates.regionalScope: Saint Petersburg 98.1 is officially selectable, but returned playlist scope is not yet proven regional
candidates.notes: Official Like FM site explicitly lists Saint Petersburg 98.1 FM and exposes current item plus minute-level timed playlist/history. However the same playlist surface is rendered while many cities are selectable and no verified SPb request parameter/cookie/API has yet been identified. Do not claim these times as Saint Petersburg-specific until selector semantics are captured.

candidates.regionalScope: official central/Moscow online feed; Saint Petersburg 103.4 exists in the official network, but no SPb-specific online metadata surface is verified
candidates.notes: Official DFM online stream page is explicitly labelled Moscow and exposes exact minute-level history including non-music items such as advertising. DFM's official regional-partner page separately lists Saint Petersburg 103.4. No evidence yet proves that the online history is the SPb feed, so do not promote it as exact Saint Petersburg metadata.

candidates.regionalScope: Saint Petersburg 95.9 is an official selectable city; exact metadata request semantics still need validation
candidates.notes: Official playlist page explicitly lists Saint Petersburg 95.9 among station cities and provides playlist lookup. Do not infer that the default playlist response is SPb until the selector's request/cookie/API is identified.
Official site exposes LIVE/history and explicitly lists Saint Petersburg 107.8. Resolve the underlying city selection/API before promotion.

candidates.regionalScope: official online surface is explicitly Moscow; no verified Saint Petersburg metadata selector/surface
candidates.notes: Official Hit FM main stream exposes exact minute-level channel history, but the page is explicitly labelled Moscow. This is useful evidence for parser/timestamp semantics but must not be represented as exact Saint Petersburg history without a verified regional endpoint or proof that SPb carries the identical feed.

candidates.regionalScope: official main online surface is Moscow; regional online variants exist (for example Omsk), but no Saint Petersburg variant has been verified
candidates.notes: Official MAXIMUM main channel exposes exact minute-level history including advertising and other non-music items. The site demonstrably supports separate regional online variants such as /oms/ and a dedicated MAXIMUM Omsk channel, proving regional divergence is possible. Therefore the Moscow history must not be silently assigned to Saint Petersburg.

candidates.regionalScope: official network site lists regional frequencies; playlist regional scope remains unproven
candidates.notes: Official ENERGY site provides a date/time song lookup and lists its regional broadcast network. The public playlist/lookup is clearly official and time-aware, but current evidence does not prove that its returned history follows a selected Saint Petersburg feed rather than the central/federal programme. Keep staged until regional request semantics are verified.
Official site has an explicit /spb/ regional surface and exposes player/history UI. Exact live/history payload still needs inspection.
